capture.runtimeTreatment: Preserve captured gameplay dependencies, content and settings; capture the future tested comparison harness and verify compatibility before allocation.

confirmationFamily: Union of the three exact controls and both selected physical recipes within each restart; measure each member once on that restart's panel.
perArmPracticalDecisions: Descriptive only; no experiment-wide team adoption or additional significance claims.
assignmentOrder: Twelve 49-value search blocks first: one root, eight discovery (candidate uses first four), eight screening, 32 selection. Then twelve 1000-value confirmation blocks. Permanently reserve every fresh word including unused tail.
endpoint: Mean paired confirmation win-rate difference over all twelve frozen selected-output pairs, conditional on the complete search.
candidateChange: Complete cost-neutral pipeline: coarser four-trial adaptive discovery, then fresh screening before nomination; no offset exploration or selector change.
abandonment: One comparison only; failed strength gates or all-identical outputs end it without promotion, retry or extension. Stage diagnostics cannot promote the closed result.
screeningRanking: Fresh screening fitness alone: descending worst-context win rate, ascending guardian health, descending survival, ascending winning duration, ordinal recipe ID.
screeningMembership: Three protected references plus twenty highest discovery-ranked challengers; all 23 frozen before the first screening fight.
nominationMembership: Three protected references plus two highest screening-ranked challengers; all five and their screening order frozen before selection.
pairing: One common root; candidate discovery is the first four of the baseline eight; a separate eight-value candidate screening panel; a common 32-value selection panel; all role panels disjoint.
